slides: Now a technique that sounds a bit funny, but it really saves points, even for strong students. We call it give it to the little guy. That means multiply the smaller amount to make the amounts equal.

slides.say: We use it when we build an equation with words like twice, or three times. It comes up a lot in age questions, and in questions about money.

slides: Let's see it in an age question. And after it, one more question about building, this time with an inequality. I'll see you in the next video.
